call_points.text: Total capital expenditure for the current financial year is expected to be ₹3,000 million ~ ₹3,500 million.
FY27 capex guided at ₹300-350 Cr, primarily for Site 5 and new R&D site.
CEM/CRAMS pipeline is the deepest ever, with 10 new marquee clients onboarded in Q1FY27.
CEM business EBITDA margins north of 28-30%, driving overall margin expansion.
Working capital intensity improved, but inventory remains elevated due to strategic positioning for new sites.
Key risks are safe execution of chemical processes and ability to deliver innovative solutions sustainably.
Site 3++ started commercial production in February end and is being ramped up.
CEM and CRAMS together contributed more than 55% of FY26 revenue.
R&D spend was ₹862.13 M, 7.3% of FY26 revenue.
50 customer and certification audits were completed in FY26.

timeline.summary: Aether Industries received a ₹4.26 Cr CGST demand and show cause notice disallowing tax credit on FY21-FY22 IPO expenses.
Aether Industries Limited’s earnings conference call scheduled for May 15, 2026, at 18:00 Hrs., led by Dr. Aman Desai, Mr. Rohan Desai, Mr. Faiz Nagariya, and Mr. Kushal Doshi.
Aether Industries reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹305.12 Cr and PAT of ₹54.01 Cr, and appointed Guenter Stevens.
Aether Industries approved Q4 FY26 financial results and appointed Guenter Stevens as Europe BD Leader.
Chitrarth Rajan Parghi, Mem. No. F12563, signed the audio recording of the Q4 FY2026 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, available at aether.co.in.
ICRA reaffirmed Aether Industries' [ICRA]A+ rating with a Stable outlook and [ICRA]A1 short-term rating on ₹296 Cr bank facilities.
Aether Industries received the final insurance claim settlement on June 5, 2026, for the November 29, 2023 fire accident.
Aether Industries Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on July 31, 2026, announcing strong financial results and a strategic R&D partnership with Dow Chemical.
Aether Industries Limited schedules earnings conference call on Friday, October 30, 2026 from 14:00 Hrs. to discuss Q2 and H1 results.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹347.22 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹68 Cr (+26.0% YoY).
On October 30, 2026, Aether Industries reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹347.2 Cr, up 24% YoY, with PAT rising 26% YoY to ₹68.0 Cr.
Aether Industries reported investor presentation details for Q2/H1 FY27, highlighting 50% YoY growth in CEM and an 88 bps expansion in H1 EBITDA margins.

Audio recording of the Earning Conference Call for the Financial Results of the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 was arranged on October 30, 2026 and placed on the company website.
